Package info.openrocket.core.simulation.flightcomputer

Class JavaBoardProgram

java.lang.Object
info.openrocket.core.simulation.flightcomputer.JavaBoardProgram
public abstract class JavaBoardProgram extends Object
API for an embedded Java board. A new program instance and class loader are created for each run.
